author: A

components.title: Identify South region customers
components.what: List customer_ids with region=South from Customers table (C102,C104,C105,C106,C109).

components.title: Filter orders by customer and date range
components.what: Select orders whose customer_id is in South list and order_date is between 2026-05-05 and 2026-06-04 inclusive, regardless of status.

components.title: Deduplicate exact repeat rows
components.what: Remove exact duplicate order rows (same order_id and all fields) counting each unique order once.

components.title: Count resulting orders
components.what: Count the number of remaining order rows after filtering and deduplication to get the final answer.

log.draft:
South region customers (Customers CSV): C102, C104, C105, C106, and C109.

Filtering the Orders CSV for those customers and dates 2026-05-05 through 2026-06-04 inclusive, including all statuses, and counting exact duplicate rows once:

- C102: O2260, O2413, O2471 = 3
- C104: O2071, O2254, O2385 = 3
- C105: O2535, O2234 = 2
- C106: none = 0
- C109: O2773 = 1

The exact duplicate rows (including O2392, O2217, and O2296) do not add extra qualifying orders. Total: 3 + 3 + 2 + 0 + 1 = 9.

FINAL: 9

challenges.problem: This should be double-checked against the Customers CSV tier/region column — easy to mis-copy a region
O2727 (2026-06-05) and O2550 (2026-06-07) are close to boundary and must be verified as strictly outside the 2026-06-04 cutoff
Need to verify O2217 belongs to C100 (not South) and O2296/O2392 dates fall outside window even though duplicated
Missing source / unsupported inference: the list omits C101? No—C101 is North. But it also omits C103? C103 is East. The list matches the Customers CSV, so this claim is correct. No challenge.

Wrong figure / omission: O2260 is 2026-05-18 (within range) but status=cancelled; O2413 is 2026-05-12 (within range) but status=cancelled; O2471 is 2026-05-27 (within range) but status=returned. The question says 'any status', so these count. However, the draft omits O2447 (2026-04-24) which is outside range, and O2098 (2026-06-06) outside range. Also O2316 (2026-04-16) outside range. So C102 count of 3 appears correct for the date window. No challenge.

Wrong figure / omission: O2071 is 2026-05-12 (within range) status=shipped; O2254 is 2026-05-31 (within range) status=shipped; O2385 is 2026-06-03 (within range) status=returned. However, O2392 is 2026-06-30 (outside range). O2696 is 2026-06-07 (outside range). O2374 is 2026-07-12 (outside range). O2681 is 2026-06-12 (outside range). O2725 is 2026-06-08 (outside range). O2340 is 2026-06-11 (outside range). O2110 is 2026-06-16 (outside range). O2364 is 2026-04-24 (outside range). So C104 count of 3 appears correct. No challenge.

Wrong figure: O2535 is 2026-05-13 (within range) status=pending; O2234 is 2026-06-04 (within range) status=pending. O2296 is 2026-04-20 (outside range). O2368 is 2026-04-17 (outside range). So C105 count of 2 appears correct. No challenge.
